title: Skill: diagram-data (ER and schema diagrams)
description: ER and class diagrams drawn from schema files and models, every entity traced to its definition.

acceptanceCriteria.text: skills/diagram-data/SKILL.md exists with name and a trigger-rich description, ending in a Reference files section
skills/diagram-data/examples/ holds at least one worked example whose diagrams pass mermaid-check and diagram_lint
Two eval cases for diagram-data are in evals/evals.json and iteration-1 with-skill vs baseline results are committed under evals/benchmarks/iteration-1/

implementationNotes: schema_er.py (CREATE/ALTER/DROP replayed in order; cardinality from NOT NULL, nullability and UNIQUE; %% ref per table; exit 3 over the cap) with 2 tests on the eval fixture. Example: the sample shop migrations at intermediate (with keys) and beginner (entities only). Evals 9 and 10: with skill 7/7 and 5/5, without 6/7 and 4/5 (iteration-1; baseline missed accessibility fields; both arms got tables, FKs and the optional coupon right). Known gaps for iteration 2: plain display names for beginner views; the eval-09 with-skill answer named the wrong migration for the dropped legacy_carts table (prose, not graded).
finalSummary: diagram-data skill: SKILL.md (schema of record first, scope to one area, generate from DDL or trace ORM models, cardinality from the schema never the names) with schema_er.py (+tests) and a generated shop data model at two levels.
